name: labs/prr8691__optosigma-gsc02c-python
title: OptoSigma GSC-02C delay stage (optosigma_gsc02c.GSC02C)
intro: OptoSigma GSC-02C delay stage (optosigma_gsc02c.GSC02C), adapted from prr8691/optosigma-gsc02c-python. It reads `position_mm`, `position_pulses`, `busy` and `status`; runs `configure_motion`, `move_absolute_mm`, `move_relative_mm`, `move_absolute_pulses` and 3 more. `configure_motion`: set the D: motion ramp used by later moves. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
